about: Which GTA sold the most? Top 3 by the last official count for each: GTA 4 25M by July 2013 (Take-Two), San Andreas 27.5M by Sept 2011 (Rockstar), GTA 5 230M+ sold-in by Aug 2026 (Take-Two), almost half of the series' ~475M. GTA 6 Nov 19. Delta, pillar 3.

lines.text: Which GTA sold the most? Guess.
lines.say: Which G T A sold the most? Guess.

lines.text: The best-selling GTA games, by the last official count.

lines.text: Number three: GTA 4. 25 million copies by 2013.
lines.say: Number three. G T A 4. Twenty five million copies, by twenty thirteen.

lines.text: Number two: San Andreas. 27.5 million by 2011.

lines.text: But number one: GTA 5. Over 230 million.
